ingredients.name: bacon, or mushrooms or other vegetables instead

steps.instruction: Flatten 14 ounces of pizza dough as thin as you can.
steps.spoken: Flatten 14 ounces of pizza dough as thin as you can, about 1/16 inch. Put it between two pieces of parchment paper and press it flat with a bottle. It should fill 2 baking sheets, so you make two large flammkuchen, one per person.

steps.instruction: Put the flat dough on baking trays.

steps.spoken: Preheat the oven to 450 to five hundred °F.

steps.instruction: Spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream over the dough in a very thin layer.
steps.spoken: Spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream or creme fraiche evenly over the dough. It should be a very thin layer that just barely covers the dough.

steps.instruction: Cut 1 onion and 5 ounces of bacon into small pieces.
Spread the onion and bacon evenly over the dough.
Bake for 10 minutes, until the thin parts turn a bit brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 minutes. Take it out when it is getting a bit dark and the thin parts are a bit brown.
